occurrences.text: When I call to remembrance the unfeigned faith that is in thee, which dwelt first in thy grandmother Lois, and thy mother Eunice; and I am persuaded that in thee also.
Yea, I think it meet, as long as I am in this tabernacle, to stir you up by putting you in remembrance;
This second epistle, beloved, I now write unto you; in both which I stir up your pure minds by way of remembrance:

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
